inputs.name: accept_oracle_license
inputs.description: Set to true to accept the Oracle Free Use Terms and Conditions, https://www.oracle.com/downloads/licenses/oracle-free-license.html, which Oracle AI Database Free is released under. The circuit downloads and installs nothing without it.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password for the SYS, SYSTEM and PDBADMIN accounts. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_admin_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: oracle_free_version
inputs.description: Release of the oracle-ai-database-free-26ai RPM, such as "23.26.3-1". Change oracle_free_sha256 with it. Raising it installs the new RPM over the old one.

inputs.name: oracle_free_sha256
inputs.description: SHA-256 of each build of the RPM, from Oracle's download page, by build: el9.x86_64, el9.aarch64 and el10.x86_64. Change it with oracle_free_version.
